notes: Regional forms are listed as separate entries but count as one species.
Purely cosmetic or in-battle forms (Vivillon patterns, Furfrou trims, Alcremie flavours, Rotom appliances, Maushold/Palafin/Aegislash forms, etc.) are not broken out.
Mega Heatran was teased for M-C but is not in the 1.2.0 update; it is expected in a December update.
Farfetch'd and Mr. Mime are the Kantonian forms, not the Galarian ones, even though Sirfetch'd and Perrserker are present.
Pawmot appears in Pokemon Zone's M-C diff but is missing from several outlets' lists, which report 34 entries instead of 35.
